macro_risk_events.description: In January 2025, social inventories of aluminum ingot in Foshan stood at about 220,000 MT, a neutral level for the year. Downstream pre-Spring Festival stocking demand was moderate, and the South China spot premium held steady at 60-90 CNY/MT.

With the Spring Festival holiday approaching, downstream processors are gradually halting production for the break, slowing the pace of spot purchases. Demand is expected to recover once work resumes after the holiday.
